conventions.grader: Frozen core grader; corrected stored inputs, no raw reparse.
conventions.baseline: Uniform majority on identical normalized stored answer strings.
conventions.h_mem: coverage minus member_selection; observed candidate-only mass, not an allocation optimality gap.
conventions.distinct_candidates: Distinct stored answer strings used by uniform majority; not a claim of semantic inequivalence.
conventions.fragmentation: Descriptive association; outcome rates conditional on bucket.
conventions.recovery_curve: Reference-answer-dependent hypothetical mass coverage. Not an executable policy or impossibility proof for weighted voting.
conventions.nested_ordering: No significance test of coverage>=member_selection; ordering follows from nested output classes. Magnitudes receive bootstrap CIs.
conventions.budget_grid: k1..9, B=2k (nine even budgets), three pairs by three benchmarks.

ratio_audit.interpretation: Exploratory ratio only; the CI is conditional on a positive denominator. Nested coverage/member output classes guarantee their ordering and do not establish that aggregation research outperforms budget allocation.
